race_name: L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France

top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mountainous highland road course, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.

Road-specific control matters at L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France. Practice on mountainous highland road course: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 72 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France's mountainous highland road course rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
72 miles on mountainous highland road course burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
At L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France. Train it until it feels boring.
2-minute all-out efforts on mountainous highland road course. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Base fitness for L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France's mountainous highland road course actually does to you.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France's 72 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.altitude: L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing. Start altitude near 2,230 meters.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at L'Étape Tlaxcala by Tour de France rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mountainous highland road course to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 72 miles of mountainous highland road course in Tlaxcala de Xicohténcatl, Tlaxcala, Mexico.
